#include <iostream>

#include <cmath>
#include <set>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

class Point;
class Circle;
class Line;

class Point {
public:
    double x, y;

    Point(double x = 0, double y = 0) : x(x), y(y) {}

    std::string toString() const {
        char buffer[100];
        snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "(%.10f,%.10f)", x, y);
        return std::string(buffer);
    }

    Point subtract(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }

    Point translate(const Line& line, double length) const;
    Point translate(const Point& vec, double length) const;

    Point add(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x + other.x, y + other.y);
    }

    Point multiply(double factor) const {
        return Point(x * factor, y * factor);
    }

    Point normalize() const {
        double len = std::sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        return Point(x / len, y / len);
    }

    Point divide(double factor) const {
        return Point(x / factor, y / factor);
    }

    Point perpendicular() const {
        return Point(-y, x);
    }

    bool equals(const Point& other) const {
        const double EPSILON = 1e-10;
        return std::abs(x - other.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - other.y) < EPSILON;
    }

    bool operator<(const Point& other) const {
        const double EPSILON = 1e-10;
        if (equals(other)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (std::abs(x - other.x) < EPSILON) {
            return y < other.y;
        }
        return x < other.x;
    }
};

class Line {
public:
    Point start;
    Point end;

    Line(const Point& start, const Point& end) : start(start), end(end) {}

    Point asDirection() const {
        return end.subtract(start);
    }

    double length() const {
        const double EPSILON = 1e-10;
        double dx = start.x - end.x;
        double dy = start.y - end.y;
        return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    }
};

class Circle {
public:
    Point center;
    int radius;

    Circle(int x, int y, int r) : center(Point(x, y)), radius(r) {}

    static bool doIntersect(const Circle& a, const Circle& b) {
        const double EPSILON = 1e-10;
        double dx = a.center.x - b.center.x;
        double dy = a.center.y - b.center.y;
        double d = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        return d <= a.radius + b.radius + EPSILON && d + EPSILON >= std::abs(a.radius - b.radius);
    }

    static bool doIntersect2(const Circle& a, const Circle& b) {
        double dx = a.center.x - b.center.x;
        double dy = a.center.y - b.center.y;
        double d = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        return d < a.radius + b.radius && d > std::abs(a.radius - b.radius);
    }

    static void computeIntersections(const Circle& a, const Circle& b, std::set<Point>& set) {
        const double EPSILON = 1e-10;
        if (!doIntersect(a, b)) {
            return;
        }

        Line line(a.center, b.center);
        double dx = a.center.x - b.center.x;
        double dy = a.center.y - b.center.y;
        double d = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        
        double middleDist = (d * d - b.radius * b.radius + a.radius * a.radius) / (2 * d);
        Point direction = line.asDirection();
        Point normalizedDir = direction.normalize();
        Point midPoint(a.center.x + normalizedDir.x * middleDist, 
                       a.center.y + normalizedDir.y * middleDist);
        
        Point perp = normalizedDir.perpendicular();
        double height = std::sqrt(a.radius * a.radius - middleDist * middleDist);
        
        Point first(midPoint.x + perp.x * height, midPoint.y + perp.y * height);
        Point second(midPoint.x - perp.x * height, midPoint.y - perp.y * height);

        set.insert(first);
        if (!second.equals(first)) {
            set.insert(second);
        }
    }
};

Point Point::translate(const Line& line, double length) const {
    return translate(line.asDirection(), length);
}

Point Point::translate(const Point& vec, double length) const {
    Point normalized = vec.normalize();
    return add(normalized.multiply(length));
}

class BlockReader {
public:
    static const int EOF = -1;
    std::istream* is;
    char buffer[4096];
    int pos, size, next;
    bool has_next;

    BlockReader(std::istream& is) : is(&is), pos(0), size(0), has_next(false) {
        next = nextByte();
    }

    int nextByte() {
        if (pos >= size) {
            is->read(buffer, sizeof(buffer));
            size = is->gcount();
            pos = 0;
            if (size == 0) {
                return EOF;
            }
        }
        return static_cast<unsigned char>(buffer[pos++]);
    }

    void skipWhitespace() {
        while (next != EOF && std::isspace(next)) {
            next = nextByte();
        }
    }

    int nextInteger() {
        skipWhitespace();
        int result = 0;
        bool negative = false;
        if (next == '+' || next == '-') {
            negative = (next == '-');
            next = nextByte();
        }
        while (next >= '0' && next <= '9') {
            result = (result * 10) + (next - '0');
            next = nextByte();
        }
        return negative ? -result : result;
    }

    bool hasMore() {
        skipWhitespace();
        return next != EOF;
    }
};

int main() {
    const double EPSILON = 1e-10;
    bool IS_ONLINE_JUDGE = true;
    
    #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    IS_ONLINE_JUDGE = false;
    #endif

    if (!IS_ONLINE_JUDGE) {
        std::ifstream file("D:\\DataBase\\TESTCASE\\codeforces\\CF933C.in");
        if (file.is_open()) {
            std::cin.rdbuf(file.rdbuf());
        }
    }

    BlockReader input(std::cin);
    
    int n = input.nextInteger();
    std::vector<Circle> circles;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x = input.nextInteger();
        int y = input.nextInteger();
        int r = input.nextInteger();
        circles.push_back(Circle(x, y, r));
    }

    if (n == 3 && !Circle::doIntersect(circles[0], circles[1])) {
        int count = 4;
        if (Circle::doIntersect2(circles[0], circles[2])) {
            count++;
        }
        if (Circle::doIntersect2(circles[1], circles[2])) {
            count++;
        }
        std::cout << count << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int total = 1;
    std::set<Point> points;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        points.clear();
        total++;
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            Circle::computeIntersections(circles[i], circles[j], points);
        }
        if (static_cast<int>(points.size()) >= 2) {
            total += points.size() - 1;
        }
    }

    std::cout << total << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
